title: label-write --release sends its comment without the signature check
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

## Finding

`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --release` builds its `Release:` comment with `composeReleaseBody`, which calls post-stamped's `renderBody` only (label-write.mjs L712–722 at `3e24b822`, the head of PR #31583). It never calls `signatureRefusal`, so a release comment with no `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION` first line goes out through the relay. Every other seat comment path refuses one (#27113): post-stamped's `main` does, and after PR #31583 so does `label-write --comment-file` through the shared `judgeBody`.

The os-dev thread for #31551 found this and left it unchanged as out of scope; the seat confirmed it by reading the source.

## Wanted

1. `--release` judges its composed body through `judgeBody(…, { mode: 'comment' }, nowMs, 'label-write')` instead of `renderBody` alone, and refuses with exit 2 and zero writes when the body is unsigned.
2. A self-test pin: an unsigned release text is refused before the stroke; a signed one still sends.

## Scope

`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` only. No relay op, no procedure text. Land after PR #31583 (it adds `judgeBody`).
